metadata.title: Upstream Kubernetes and containerized workloads: ITSP.10.033-01 Medium control implementation
metadata.remarks: Generated from itsg33-kubernetes-mapping.csv and oscal/policy/src/rules.csv. Describes what upstream Kubernetes and a workload can implement, and which Kyverno rules check it; it is not an assessment of any system. Controls the mapping marks External are deliberately absent: they are the gap.

components.title: Upstream Kubernetes
components.description: Upstream Kubernetes (kube-apiserver, kubelet, etcd, and the built-in admission and authorization stack), configured by a cluster administrator. No distribution-specific or third-party component is assumed.

control-implementations.description: Upstream Kubernetes against the ITSP.10.033-01 Medium profile.

implemented-requirements.description: ServiceAccounts; OIDC to corporate IdP; RBAC RoleBindings.
RBAC (Roles, ClusterRoles); --authorization-mode=Node,RBAC.
NetworkPolicy; Gateway API; namespace boundaries.
Namespace partitioning + RBAC scoping.
Fine-grained RBAC verbs; no wildcards; controlled system:masters.

statements.description: Checked offline by the Kyverno rules restrict-wildcard-verbs, restrict-binding-system-groups, restrict-automount-sa-token.

implemented-requirements.description: Short OIDC token lifetimes via IdP; dashboard idle timeout. Titled Session lock under Annex 3A.
kube-apiserver behind VPN or bastion; pair with SI-400 and AC-17(400).
kube-apiserver audit policy file.
Audit policy; log or webhook backend.
Log forwarding to external store; PV sizing.
Read-only audit forwarding; separate audit credentials.
Audit policy rules with level RequestResponse for security-relevant resources; Metadata elsewhere.
Declarative manifests under GitOps (Argo CD, Flux).

statements.description: Checked offline by the Kyverno rules disallow-latest-tag.

implemented-requirements.description: PR review on infra repo; admission webhooks.
Pod Security Admission restricted profile; OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno.

statements.description: Checked offline by the Kyverno rules disallow-capabilities, disallow-host-namespaces, disallow-host-path, disallow-host-ports, disallow-host-process, disallow-privileged-containers, disallow-proc-mount, disallow-selinux, restrict-apparmor-profiles, restrict-seccomp, restrict-sysctls, disallow-capabilities-strict, disallow-privilege-escalation, require-run-as-non-root-user, require-run-as-nonroot, restrict-seccomp-strict, restrict-volume-types.

implemented-requirements.description: Pod Security restricted; anonymous auth off; insecure ports off.

statements.description: Checked offline by the Kyverno rules disallow-host-namespaces, disallow-host-path, disallow-host-ports, disallow-privileged-containers, disallow-capabilities-strict.

implemented-requirements.description: API inventory; inventory CRDs; SBOMs attached to images and checked at admission.
OIDC to IdP enforcing MFA; short-lived tokens.
kubelet TLS bootstrap; CSR approval workflow.
Projected service-account tokens with audience and expiry; token rotation.

statements.description: Checked offline by the Kyverno rules restrict-automount-sa-token.

implemented-requirements.description: Namespaces; control-plane/data-plane separation.

statements.description: Checked offline by the Kyverno rules disallow-default-namespace.

implemented-requirements.description: ResourceQuotas; LimitRanges; API Priority and Fairness.

statements.description: Checked offline by the Kyverno rules require-requests-limits.

implemented-requirements.description: NetworkPolicy default-deny; Ingress; egress gateway.
TLS on kube-apiserver; etcd peer TLS; service-mesh mTLS.
KMS provider plugin for etcd encryption at rest.
FIPS-validated modules; CSE-approved crypto per ITSP.40.111.
TLS everywhere; mTLS via mesh; anonymous endpoints disabled.
etcd encryption at rest; CSI encrypted volumes.
Patch cadence policy; managed control plane; node image rotation.
kube-apiserver audit logs; metrics-server.
Cluster-admin kubectl, GitOps writes, and KMS admin only from a dedicated isolated workstation. New in ITSP.10.033-01; Canadian-specific.
Restrict system:masters and cluster-admin bindings to identities originating from the SI-400 workstation. New in ITSP.10.033-01; Canadian-specific.

statements.description: Checked offline by the Kyverno rules restrict-clusteradmin-subjects.

components.title: Containerized workload
components.description: The application running on the cluster. These requirements are the application team's share of the control, distinct from the cluster's.

control-implementations.description: Containerized workload against the ITSP.10.033-01 Medium profile.

implemented-requirements.description: App-level RBAC inside the workload.
Structured app logging to stdout.
App-level OIDC or SAML for end users.
App-level TLS termination when no mesh.
App-level field encryption or envelope encryption.
In-app input validation.
Sanitized error handling in app code.

components.title: Kyverno
components.description: The Kyverno CLI, evaluating the rules offline against Kubernetes manifests. It checks the Upstream Kubernetes component's configuration; it does not implement any control.
